task: Follow-up repair: substitution-aware whole-string read pass (A), stdin exemption narrowed to pattern-taking searches (B), dist rebuild (last writer)

fixes.A: The whole-string READ pass now runs only when the command carries a command substitution (`$(` or a backtick). With no substitution the segmentation is complete, so the pass is skipped (this removed the false refusals of `cat docs/decisions.md && ls packages` / `... && rm -rf node_modules`). With a substitution the whole line is still judged, and every substituted body is judged as its own command with the existence requirement relaxed to path-shaped tokens.
fixes.B: The stdin exemption is restricted to the pattern-taking searches (rg, grep, ag, ack, i.e. `patternFirst`); `find` and `rg --files` never read stdin, so a piped one is judged exactly like a first-stage one (`git log | find` is refused).
